bootstrap.install: installLocalBackend(GameServiceBase,{search:location.search}) before first service init/connect; then installProgressHooks(original GameData class,runtime).
bootstrap.quiet: reaDevelopmentMute=1 changes response sound flags only; persisted normal sound preferences remain untouched
bootstrap.notify: Transport delivers original {type:jackpotUpdate,data:{jp-mini,jp-minor,jp-major,jp-grand}} before callback to actual registered notify listeners.

requiredHooks.guard: response.localBackend===true; no changes to original nonlocal parsing
requiredHooks.reason: Actual E parser resets index0 on initial, ignoring localResumeIndex. Hook restores exact persisted state/transpose/winSymbols/game type and marks native stage advances. Backend refuses early FG settlement until the final native stage.
Original popup reads totalWinnings; local JP stage may contain ordinary line winnings plus jackpot. Popup must use jpWinnings while trophy UPDATE_TOTAL_WINNINGS retains totalWinnings.
requiredHooks.change: Use jpWinnings only for local popup count target. Keep the overall trophy amount sourced from currentState.totalWinnings. Preserve ordinary source behavior for nonlocal rounds.

requiredHooks.reason: Must install independent runtime before first services or App-dependent singleton constructor. Do not execute captured debug STATIC sender paths.
requiredHooks.change: Use the parent integration tool; no modifications supplied to root source here.

nativeContract.selection: selectFgMultiple is server-chosen trigger state, not an event/request; UI chosen card only reveals that value.
nativeContract.purchase: Only self-defined local featureIndex0/freeGame is enabled. Original GameSender.buyFeature gets engine.gameState as an object {spinId}; subsequent GameSender.spin({spinId}) receives the exact already generated State[]. No second debit.
nativeContract.close: Original MG_CLOSE_SPIN_STATE/FG_CLOSE_SPIN_STATE callback chain settles once; repeating close does not recredit.
nativeContract.resume: initial returns full pending chain plus localResumeIndex; supplied progress hook restores actual original parser position.
